articles.title: Right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round of Brazil election
articles.description: With neither candidate getting more than 50% of the vote, the election will go to a run-off on 25 October.

articles.title: Watch: How Brazil's dramatic election unfolded
articles.description: Millions of Brazilians took to the polls on Sunday for the first round of the country's presidential elections.

articles.title: US air force removes all bombers from British military base RAF Fairford
articles.description: No reason has been given for the withdrawal, but it follows a major incident last week when police were alerted to "suspicious vehicles" near the airbase.

articles.title: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit
articles.description: Footage shows a drone hitting the Pivnichyi (Northern) Bridge as vehicles move across it, creating a large fireball.

articles.title: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis
articles.description: The Yemeni president's announcement comes amid an exchange of strikes between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition.

articles.title: Watch: What we know about Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges
articles.description: BBC Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson is near Kyiv's Northern Bridge, which has been hit for the second day in a row.

articles.title: Why Canada is wargaming a (long shot) US invasion
articles.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney has said the military is running scenarios in the unlikely case the US invades Canada.

articles.title: Why has Brazil accused the US of election interference?
articles.description: The Latin American country will vote for its next president, as Lula da Silva and Bolsonaro clash over sovereignty, security and ties with Washington.

articles.title: Will Spain's housing crisis lead to a snap election?
articles.description: The BBC's Guy Hedgecoe is in Madrid, where a series of marches have been scheduled, after Spain's Congress rejected measures aimed at tackling the country's housing crisis.

articles.title: Spanish PM calls snap election
articles.description: Spain's prime minister Pedro Sanchez has called a snap election for next month.

articles.title: Thousands of Imran Khan supporters march towards Pakistan's barricaded capital
articles.description: Supporters of Imran Khan, Pakistan's former prime minister, have started a march towards the capital Islamabad to demand his release from prison.

articles.title: Flydubai co-pilot: Australian links probed after 'axe attack' on captain
articles.description: Australian authorities are investigating a flydubai co-pilot's "links to Australia"  after he attacked the captain ​on a Tel Aviv-bound flight.

articles.title: Tens of thousands protest against Spain's housing crisis
articles.description: Tens of thousands of people have taken to the streets of Spanish cities in protest at the country's housing crisis in the wake of the forcible eviction of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal.
